}}'''Varek''' is a [[Seanchan]] Under-Lieutenant in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].{{ref/book|twotc|Varek}}

== Appearance ==
He is skinny.

== Activities ==
He was in the battle of [[Falme]], but considered the [[Battle of Altara]] to be worse. He rode under [[Kennar Miraj]] in the attack against [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces. Miraj sent him to fetch a ''[[morat]]'[[torm]]'' scouting report. Miraj's urgency was such that he sent Varek on foot even though it could (and did{{ref/book|twotc|Varek}}) cost Varek ''[[sei'taer]]'' because Miraj did not wish to waste time finding a horse for Varek.{{ref/book|8|24}}

Varek's report was:

{{Quote
 | quote                    = The enemy is less than five miles due east, my Lord Captain-General, marching in our direction. They are deployed in five columns spaced approximately one mile apart.
 | speakers                 = Varek
 | addressees               = Kennar Miraj
 | topic                    = the advance of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces during the [[Battle of Altara]].
 | other_refs               = {{ref/book|8|24}}
}}

Later, Varek witnessed a hundred [[Taraboner]] lancers defeated by a single [[Asha'man]], with those who didn't flee quickly enough being literally "ripped to shreds."{{ref/book|8|24}}

''En route'' to report to [[Banner-General]] [[Chianmai]], Varek killed a man, likely a [[Cairhienin]] under [[Dalthanes Annallin]], in battle with the forces of Dalthanes, [[Sunamon Haellin]], and [[Gregorin Panar den Lushenos]]. He regretted the death of the man's bay which he perceived to be superior to his own white-footed dun. Varek then discovered a dozen [[Altaran]] lancers and intended to assumed command but they were quickly eliminated by the crossbowmen of the [[Legion of the Dragon]].{{verify}} Shortly thereafter, he discovered some Seanchan-aligned Westlander soldiers, a ''[[sul'dam]]'' with her ''[[damane]]'' [[Zakai]], and the corpse of Chianmai. A Taraboner reported to Varek that the ''[[damane]]'''s "lightnings" had fallen among the Seanchan forces after engaging an [[Illianer]] force.{{ref/book|8|24}}

Varek assumed command and ordered a retreat,{{ref/book|8|24}} for which he was likely promoted{{ref/book|twotc|Varek}} despite fearing that failure would end with him in custody of the [[Seekers for Truth]].{{ref/book|8|24}}
